prompt: Challenge C119-CH1: We produce roughly 600 packaging variants a year and our senior designer spends two days per project manually fitting artwork into structura

content.text:
Let me analyze the challenge: automate artwork fitting into structural dielines for packaging variants - reading dieline structure, identifying printable panels, placing/scaling artwork with minimal manual correction.

Core work: Build a system that parses structural dielines, identifies printable panels, and automatically places/scales artwork into those panels - requiring computational geometry, dieline parsing, and layout automation.

R0626 (Ildikó Papp): Keywords include "dieline registration," "parametric packaging templates," "artwork alignment," "constraint-based design." Publications include parametric dieline generation (SYN-PUB-07151) and PDF/X compliance verification. This is directly on point - can_do.
R0519 (Rastko Malešević) deals more with parametric layout for document/publication composition rather than packaging dielines specifically, so only partly relevant. R0438 (Saša Pekez) focuses on regulatory compliance and structured authoring, which doesn't connect to dieline automation. R0436 (Ana Bogićević) covers optical security features, which isn't relevant here either.
